|descr= {{Feature|important|This command is a work in progress and can evolve until release on stable branch.}}
Getter for [[hideActions]], see also [[shownAction]]. 

|s1= [[hiddenActions]] filter

|p1= filter: [[Array]] - Array of [[Number]]s - actions to check if hidden or [] to check all. See [[shownAction]] for numbers meaning

|r1= [[Array]] - Array of [[Number]]s - actions that are hidden or [] if none is hidden. See [[shownAction]] for numbers meaning

|x1= <sqf>if (hiddenActions [] isEqualTo []) then { hint "No actions have been harmed during script execution" };</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>if (hiddenActions [91] isEqualTo [91]) then { hint "User actions have been hidden" };</sqf>
|x3= <sqf>hiddenActions []; // [2] - GetInDriver is hidden</sqf>
|x4= <sqf>hiddenActions [1, 2, 4]; // [1,4] - from GetInCommander/Driver/Gunner only Commander and Gunner are hidden</sqf>
